Then I figured maybe my body needs more natural. So I tried to use the charcoals based. It worked for maybe a week, then the issue started again. I’ve always seen the Lume advertisement and wanted to try it! So I ordered from Amazon when I got the email it was available!! Here’s my review…  Vanilla is my favorite scent for any type of bod

Seems like often when I try vegan or all natural type products, they never work for me.  Lume delivers for sure.  2 things, it’s a creme but it dries really quickly.  And the smell is 🤢not good. As another added benefit to menopause the constant hot flashes cause me to smell not so fresh long after a shower.  I have tried many products the past few years. I saw this on Instagram and found it on Amazon for faster delivery. It creates almost a silky barrier when you apply. I am fresh everywhere for at least 24 hours. I have not tried beyond that as I’m not going to push it!
The initial smell of the unscented one gave us pause. But it works and lasts! And the smell is just during application and the other scents are better.

Good news it has worked for me for the full 12 hour work day. I usually use the solid Secret Clinical Strength. This Lume has more of a gel deodorant feel than the stick.  I spend all day on my feet walking a total of 10,000-16,000 steps a day fixing hardware. Secrets good but Lume is two hours better for me.

I was sooo disappointed to find out that each of these Lume products truly STINK! I made the mistake of buying 3 different flavors and each one smells like ButtCracks!! Thank God I didnt put it on my body. Seriously this company should be ashamed! Funky Stuff !!!

reviews.t: Product works but could use improvement in the way it smells.
reviews.x: I decided to try Lume because I hate the way my old deodorant cakes under my arms and embeds into my clothing.  White clothing turns yellow and is quickly ruined.  Darker clothes show the white residue as it has worked completely into the fabric.  By the end of the day, a weird funk develops that's like a mixture of sweat and deodorant that's rather off-putting.  Lume does last the full day, but I wouldn't say it lasts 72 hours as advertised. Love all 3 scents.  Very light.  I bought the unscented first and hated it.  Hardly unscented.  I was ready to move on.  Then I read the reviews of these 3 and figured I'd try one more time.  Glad I did.  Does exactly what Lume advertises.  I'm hooked.

This product all three smells so bad I threw them in the garbage. Don’t Buy These Please You Will Hate The Smell And You Can’t Use Them Or You Will Stink Bad. Telling The Truth So Help Me God 🙏🏾 Connie Sanders Raleigh NC

reviews.t: This is not a stick - it's liquid
reviews.x: This is a liquid/cream not a stick deodorant. The company does make a stick version. I don't know if it's sold on Amazon. I haven't used deodorant in about 40 years, but I was looking for something that would help with under-boob and nether-region sweat management. Works great!

The first 3 days was great using this product. I bought 6! The 4th day of using, I began to have an odor I never smelled before on my body. Somehow the product just quit working or my body got used to it. Either way? 78$ not spent well. Never again.

I've tried the tangerine scent (which does not smell of citrus)! (I use it only as an underarm deodorant). It's nice to feel fresh during the day without the icky build-up of an antiperspirant!  It is better than most other brands I've used.

claims.text: Many reviewers say the product effectively controls odor and lasts through long days, including full work shifts.
A common complaint is that the product has an unpleasant or foul smell, with some reviewers finding it so bad they threw it away.
Some reviewers report the product stopped working after a few days or failed to control odor for a full shift.
Several reviewers note the unscented version does not actually smell unscented, while the scented versions are preferred.
Reviewers describe the texture as a liquid or gel rather than a solid stick.
